answer: Whether agents monitor a lagoon, price timber, or map a meadow, each must lock 100 tokens in a registry contract to claim one concurrent job slot. The bond stays locked until 30 days after its last job, so an attacker cannot recycle the same tokens through fresh identities to gain more slots. Running 1,000 fake agents therefore requires locking 100,000 tokens, imposing capital and opportunity costs proportional to the capacity seized.
